## About

These graphs show you the current status of our clusters and which tools are being run on [UseGalaxy.be](https://usegalaxy.be). Our primary cluster is a Condor cluster running in the [Flemish Supercomputer Center tier-1 Cloud](https://docs.vscentrum.be/cloud/index.html).

targets.query: SELECT "users" FROM "active_users" WHERE ("host" = 'usegalaxy.be') AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "timespan"
SELECT mean("count") FROM "cluster.queue" WHERE ("host" = 'usegalaxy.be') AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "state" fill(none)

panels.description: Shows how many users are using which template.

targets.query: SELECT last("user_count") as "Count" FROM "user_file_source_utilisation" GROUP BY "template_id"::tag

panels.title: User based repository utilisation (BYOD)

panels.description: Shows how many users are using which template.

targets.query: SELECT LAST("user_count") as "Count" FROM "user_object_store_utilisation" GROUP BY "template_id"::tag

panels.title: User based Galaxy storage usage (BYOS)

panels.description: Shows the resource utilization of the entire HTCondor  cluster utilization by Galaxy

targets.query: SELECT last("total_detected_cpus") AS "Total CPU cores", last("claimed_cpus") AS "Claimed CPU cores", last("unclaimed_cpus") AS "Unclaimed CPU cores", last("total_memory") /(1024*1024) AS "Total mem (TiB)", last("claimed_memory")  /(1024*1024) AS "Claimed mem (TiB)", last("unclaimed_memory") /(1024*1024) AS "Unclaimed mem (TiB)", last("total_gpu_slots") AS "Total GPU hosts", last("claimed_gpus") AS "Claimed GPU hosts", last("unclaimed_gpus") AS "Unclaimed GPU hosts", last("total_slots") AS "Total slots", last("claimed_busy_slots") AS "Claimed busy slots", last("unclaimed_idle_slots") AS "Unclaimed idle slots" FROM "htcondor_cluster_usage" WHERE ("classad" = '\'machine\'') AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "group"
